sources.rationale: Keep existing core JCS domain-separated fingerprint and explicit pair roles; donor six-field format cannot replace the approved eight-field contract.
Reuse existing numeric nonbool finite shape checks; add overflow-safe L2 unit-norm validation. Unnormalized finite values remain unchanged.
Repeated boundary checks and full-space fail-closed logic; RRF/retrieval stay outside P5.1.
Equal-dimension mutation and no-call assertions adapted to registry and observed output.
Pin immutable per-call space; do not use global model settings or legacy fallback.
Host precomputed vectors use the same validation pipeline; no Python/LlamaIndex runtime import.
Scoped retrieval and fusion belong to subsequent items; no FAISS/LlamaIndex import or automatic degradation.
Checkpoint recovery/exact identity patterns adapted to pre-send durable unknown receipts, explicit attempts, and atomic idempotent acceptance.
